description: AI‑first, zero‑dependency Node.js framework that outperforms Express & Fastify with instant edge deployment, type‑safe routing, and built‑in zero‑trust security.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages 2026's AI‑driven edge trend: built‑in LLM routing, zero‑trust defaults, and one‑click deployment to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel and Bun/Deno runtimes—no extra dependencies, no config friction, and TypeScript‑first type safety that beats Express and Fastify on speed and security.
download_hooks: Developers choose yantravese because it eliminates the need for a middleware ecosystem—everything you need is baked in, cutting bundle size and upgrade headaches.
Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond routing latency on edge runtimes, delivering up to 3× faster response times than Express/Fastify under real‑world traffic.
Zero‑config TypeScript routing, AI‑generated OpenAPI docs, and built‑in security policies give a frictionless developer experience that lets you ship production‑grade APIs in minutes.
